text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I handed Dream Journey the fan letters that arrived for her.
She read through them for a while, but now seems lost
in thought holding one particular letter.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, this letter.
It's from an elementary school boy.
An invitation was enclosed with it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, a painting he made of me won an award.
I was invited to the award ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Since we have this opportunity,
why don't we pay them a visit?
I would like to offer my congratulations and express my gratitude for their support.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, why don't you join in too, Trainer?
It's a great opportunity to interact with the fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The event venue inside the art museum.
The award-winning painting was on display there as well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
So this is the drawing of me.
I see, it depicts me during a race.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
A deep black floating amidst vivid green...
The layers of color give it such profound depth.
The way it captures dynamism is innovative too... Wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's Dream Journey-san!
You looked at my drawing?!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was astonished. You possess
such keen observational skills. Your free and bold expression
is wonderfully original as well.

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I got praised!
I really wanted to capture that sharp, cool running style, so I worked super hard on it!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: You know, I wanted to make it super strong like a black hole, but also look really cool like the sun...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This black light that seems to be flying.
Indeed... that does sound like me.

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Um, Dream Journey-san.
Could I take a picture with you and this child?
I'd like to post it on social media, if that's alright...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I don't mind at all.
If I can add a touch of grace to your special day,
I would be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"……Once again, congratulations on your award.
And thank you for this wonderful painting, as well as this encounter."

text_block_list.name: Participant
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, excuse me. May I join too?
I've been a fan for so long...!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, gladly.
Everyone over there too? One at a time, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey smiled the entire time,
graciously attending to her fans...
And then, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, this is seriously insane...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Journey-san.
This is totally blowing up online!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Going viral...?
Ah, the photos from the other day's award ceremony.
This young boy here was kind enough to invite me."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No, not that.
Everyone's constantly saying things like "God-tier fan service" and "She's officially my fave."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I merely agreed to take a commemorative photo.
I had no idea it would cause such a stir.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I'm so glad the fans enjoyed it.
